title: Pixel Agents - Your AI Agents Got a Virtual Office

slides.heading:
Your AI Agents
Now Have a
Virtual Office
slides.body:
Meet Pixel Agents
The extension that turned
AI coding into a spectator sport

slides.heading: This Is the Office
slides.body:
Your AI agents sit at desks, walk around,
and work in a pixel art office in real time

slides.heading: The Problem
slides.body:
You fire up Claude Code
It starts working in the background

Just a blinking cursor
and a wall of scrolling text

Zero visual feedback
on what your agent is doing

What if you could actually
watch your AI agents work?

Not read logs.
Watch them.

slides.heading: Enter Pixel Agents
slides.body:
A free VS Code extension
that turns your AI coding agents
into animated pixel art characters

They walk, sit at desks, type code
and react to what the agent
is actually doing in real time

slides.heading: Meet the Characters
slides.body:
Six unique pixel art characters
Each one represents a different coding agent

slides.heading: Install in 30 Seconds
slides.body:
Search "Pixel Agents" in VS Code Extensions
or run this command:
slides.code:
# Option 1: VS Code Marketplace
# Open Extensions (Ctrl+Shift+X)
# Search: "Pixel Agents"
# Click Install

# Option 2: Command Line
code --install-extension pablodelucca.pixel-agents

# Then in VS Code:
# Cmd+Shift+P > "Pixel Agents: Open Office"
# Click "+Agent" to spawn a character

cards.title: Watches Transcripts
cards.desc:
Reads Claude Code's JSONL files
to track what each agent is doing

cards.title: Spawns Characters
cards.desc:
Each terminal you open creates
a new pixel character in the office

cards.title: Animates Actions
cards.desc:
Writing code? Character types
Searching files? Character reads

slides.heading: Agents at Work
slides.body:
Characters react in real time to what
your AI agent is doing behind the scenes

slides.heading: What Gets Animated?
slides.body:
- Writing code: character types at desk
- Reading files: character reads documents
- Running commands: character runs around
- Waiting for input: speech bubble appears
- Idle: character walks to break room

cards.title: 64x64 Grid Editor
cards.desc:
Design floors, walls, and rooms
with a built-in layout editor

cards.title: Furniture Catalog
cards.desc:
Desks, chairs, bookshelves, plants
All included out of the box

cards.title: Multiple Rooms
cards.desc:
Break room, meeting room, work area
Customize everything

slides.body:
It does nothing productive.
But developers can't stop watching it.

That's how you know
it solves a real UX problem.

cards.title: Visual Agent Feedback
cards.desc:
See what your agent is doing
without reading terminal logs

cards.title: Covered by Fast Company
cards.desc:

slides.heading: The Bigger Picture
slides.body:
AI agents are becoming teammates
not just tools

Visualizing their work builds trust
and gives you instant feedback

This is just the beginning of
how we'll interact with AI agents
